# Nanonets

## Get Nanonets and its investors as data

Look up any company's investors, or any investor's full portfolio, through one API key or MCP. A free account also opens Ask AI searches and alerts when Accel adds a company.

Get free API key →Work email, sign-in link by email. Already have an account? [Log in](https://vcinfo.io/account)

[Your API key](https://vcinfo.io/account) [Read the docs](https://vcinfo.io/docs/companies)

- **Ask AI** 5 plain-English investor searches a day
- **Full lists** Every portfolio row and two-firm overlap
- **API and MCP** 100 REST or MCP calls a month, one key
- **Alerts** Follow 5 investors for portfolio and fund changes

**VCinfo API** Copy

```
$ curl -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY" \
  https://api.vcinfo.io/v1/companies/nanonets.com/investors

# also
GET /v1/companies/nanonets.com
GET /v1/companies/nanonets.com/news
```
